units: <cite ref="Yoma 40b">Yoma 40ᵇ</cite> <he>אל</he> … <he>למינין לִרְדּוֹת</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>לצדוקים</he>) give the heretics no occasion to rebel (to argue in favor of their heresy); <cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 3:7">Tosef. ib. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 2:2">II</cite>), 2 <he>לרדות אחריכם</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>לרדותן אחריהם</he>, corr. acc.) to rebel after you are gone; <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 3:3">Par. III, 3</cite>; Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. II, Par. 2.

senses.gloss: to chastise. Mekh. Mishp. s. 4 הרוֹדֶה בבנו ובתלמידו he who chastises his son or his pupil (and kills him); Macc. II, 2 הרב הרודה את וכ׳ the teacher that punishes his pupil.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 50">Gen. R. s. 50</cite>, end <he>בקש לִרְדוֹתָן</he> and wanted to punish them; a. fr.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8:12">Gen. R. s. 8</cite> (ref. to <he>ורדו</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 1:28">Gen. I, 28</cite>) <he>אם זכה רְדוּ ואם לאו יֵרְדוּ</he> if man is good, (God says,) ‘rule’, if not, (God says,) ‘let them go down’; <cite ref="Genesis 1:28">ib.</cite> (ref. to <he>וירדו</he>, ib. 26 <he>את שהוא … יִרְדּוּ את שאינו … יֵרְדוּ</he> (not <he>ורדו</he>) concerning such as are ‘in our image and likeness’ (I say,) ‘they shall rule’ &c.

<cite ref="Genesis 1:28">Ib.</cite> <he>יבא … ויִרְדֶּה למי וכ׳</he> let ‘our image and likeness’ (the good man) rule over him who is not &c.; Yalk. ib. 14.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 9:12">Tosef. Ter. IX, 12</cite> ed. Zuck. <he>ירדנו</he>, v. <cite ref="P01420"><he>עִרְעֵד</he> III</cite>.]
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 20:14">Ex. R. s. 20</cite> <he>עד שאֲרַדֶּה אותן וכ׳</he> until I drive them into the sea.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>לא רִידָּהוּ</he> he did not chastise him.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1">Ib.</cite> <he>ולא רידהו ביסורין</he> he did not punish him with sufferings.
Ib. (play on ארדון, I Chr. II, 18, as a surname of Caleb) שר׳ את יצרו he chastised (or subjugated, v. supra) his evil inclination.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 959:16">Yalk. Prov. 959</cite> <he>אֲרַדֶּה אותך וכ׳</he> (or <he>אֶרְדֶּה</he>) I shall punish thee with them; a. e.

<cite ref="Eruvin 104a:6">Erub. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>חצר … תבּן ומְרַדֶּה בה</he> (Alf. <he>מדדה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40) if a court has been made impassable through rain, he may bring straw and make a path with it; <cite ref="Eruvin 104a:6">ib.</cite> <he>וכשהוא מרדה אינו מרדה וכ׳</he> and when he makes the path, he must not do so by carrying the straw in a basket &c.
